description: Replace JWT_SECRET_KEY with JWT_SECRET and ADMIN_JWT_SECRET in config.py. Python must read the same environment variables as SHC (JWT_SECRET for user tokens, ADMIN_JWT_SECRET for admin tokens). Update get_jwt_config() to return both secrets. This fixes the parallel authentication system where Python and SHC used different secrets.
steps: Read services/project-ai/app/auth/config.py lines 10-39 to understand current structure

Add ADMIN_JWT_SECRET environment variable (with JWT_SECRET fallback matching SHC pattern from packages/auth/src/token.service.ts lines 90-94)
Update get_jwt_config() to return dict with user_secret (from JWT_SECRET) and admin_secret (from ADMIN_JWT_SECRET with fallback)
Keep existing validation: both secrets must be >= 32 characters
Update error messages to reference JWT_SECRET instead of JWT_SECRET_KEY
Create services/project-ai/.env.example with JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, JWT_ALGORITHM, JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES (document SHC alignment)
